text:
[issue by Ctoer1]
### Minecraft Version

1.21.1

### Mod Loader

NeoForge

### Describe the Issue

After the latest update I can't open the Waystones GUI without worlds crashing back to the main menu, it seems to be a compatibility issue with something else as loading a different instance of the game with only Waystones and its prerequisites doesn't cause a world crash.

### Logs

[latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29646197/latest.log)

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
You have WaystonesSable installed, which makes a lot of invasive changes to Waystones.

WaystonesSable is not yet compatible with this update.

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
Fixed in latest versions of Waystones and WaystonesSable.
